convert_tf_checkpoint_to_pytorch: convert a TensorFlow MobileNetV2 checkpoint to a PyTorch model and save to a local directory
build_tf_to_pytorch_map: build a mapping between TensorFlow and PyTorch MobileNetV2 model weights for conversion
load_tf_weights_in_mobilenet_v2: load TensorFlow checkpoint weights into a PyTorch MobileNetV2 model with proper tensor transposition
get_mobilenet_v2_config: get a MobileNetV2Config object parsed from a model name string with depth multiplier and image size
convert_movilevit_checkpoint: run the full MobileNetV2 conversion pipeline from TensorFlow checkpoint to PyTorch with optional hub upload
